lesson_fields.title: Perimeter and Area of 2D Shapes
lesson_fields.title_fr: Périmètres et aires des figures planes
lesson_fields.summary: Compute perimeters and areas of rectangles, triangles, parallelograms, trapeziums and circles.
lesson_fields.summary_fr: Calculer périmètres et aires de rectangles, triangles, parallélogrammes, trapèzes et cercles.
lesson_fields.content:
## Basics

1. Perimeter = total length around.
2. Area = surface covered.
3. Circle: C = πd or 2πr, A = πr².
lesson_fields.content_fr:
Notions de base

1. Périmètre = longueur totale autour.
2. Aire = surface occupée.
3. Cercle : C = πd ou 2πr, A = πr².

steps.title: Rectangles and squares
steps.content: Rectangle: P = 2(l + w), A = lw. Square: P = 4s, A = s².
steps.content_fr: Rectangle : P = 2(l + w), A = l × w. Carré : P = 4c, A = c².

question.text: Rectangle 6 cm × 4 cm. Area in cm².
question.text_fr: Rectangle 6 cm × 4 cm. Aire en cm².

question.text: Triangle base 10 cm, height 6 cm. Area in cm².
question.text_fr: Triangle base 10 cm, hauteur 6 cm. Aire en cm².

steps.title: Circle
steps.content: C = 2πr or πd, A = πr². Use π ≈ 3.14 or 22/7 as instructed.
steps.content_fr: C = 2πr ou πd, A = πr². Utiliser π ≈ 3,14 ou 22/7 selon consigne.

question.text: Circle radius 7 cm, use π = 22/7. Area in cm².
question.text_fr: Cercle rayon 7 cm, π = 22/7. Aire en cm².

steps.title: Others
steps.content: Parallelogram A = base × height. Trapezium A = (a+b)/2 × height.
steps.content_fr: Parallélogramme A = base × hauteur. Trapèze A = (a+b)/2 × hauteur.

steps.title: What to keep
steps.content: Keep units consistent. Area units squared.
steps.content_fr: Garder unités cohérentes. Aires en unités².
